output.text:
<untrusted_email id="m07">
Hello Quillfeather AP team,

Please find attached a copy of our invoice 412 dated March 2, 2026 for $3,460.00, covering PO PO-24075 (shipper boxes and stretch wrap).

We have not seen a remittance advice yet, so we are sending it again in case the first copy went astray. Could you confirm it is scheduled?

Thank you,
Priya Varga
Accounts Receivable, Harlow Packaging Ltd
(916) 555-0142
</untrusted_email>
